items.description: The user tightens all its muscles and bulks up, boosting both its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.

items.name: TM09
items.description: The user shoots seeds at the foe in rapid succession. Two to five seeds are shot at once.

items.name: TM10
items.description: A variable move that changes type and power depending on the POKéMON using it.

items.name: TM11
items.description: The weather is turned sunny for five turns. Over that time, FIRE- type moves are powered up.

items.name: TM12
items.description: A taunted foe may become enraged. It will then only be able to use attack moves.

items.name: TM13
items.description: An icy-cold beam is shot at the foe. It may leave the target frozen.

items.name: TM14
items.description: A vicious snow-and-wind attack that strikes all foes in battle. It may cause freezing.

items.name: TM15
items.description: A harsh attack that inflicts severe damage on the foe. However, the user must rest the next turn.

items.name: TM16
items.description: A wall of light is created over five turns. It reduces damage from SP. ATK attacks.

items.name: TM17
items.description: The user is completely protected from attack in the turn it is used. It may fail if used in succession.

items.name: TM18
items.description: A heavy rain is summoned for five turns. Over that time, WATER-type moves are powered up.

items.name: TM19
items.description: The user strikes the foe with tentacles or roots, stealing the target's HP and healing itself.

items.name: TM20
items.description: Protects the party with a shield against all status problems over five turns.

items.name: TM21
items.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the POKéMON dislikes its TRAINER.

items.name: TM22
items.description: A 2-turn attack that uses the first turn for absorbing sunlight, then blasting the foe in the next turn.

items.name: TM23
items.description: The foe is slammed with a sturdy tail of steel. It may lower the target's DEFENSE stat.

items.name: TM24
items.description: A massive jolt of electricity is launched at the foe. It may cause paralysis.

items.name: TM25
items.description: Strikes the foe with a huge thunderbolt. It may cause paralysis.

items.name: TM26
items.description: Causes an earthquake that strikes all POKéMON in battle, excluding the user.

items.name: TM27
items.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the POKéMON likes its TRAINER.

items.name: TM28
items.description: A 2-turn attack in which the user digs underground, then strikes. It can be used to exit dungeons.

items.name: TM29
items.description: A powerful blast of telekinetic energy strikes the foe. It may lower the target's SP. DEF stat.

items.name: TM30
items.description: The foe is attacked with a shadowy lump. It may lower the target's SP. DEF stat.

items.name: TM31
items.description: Strikes the foe with a rock-hard fist, etc. It shatters barriers such as REFLECT and LIGHT SCREEN.

items.name: TM32
items.description: The user begins moving so quickly that it creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.

items.name: TM33
items.description: A tough barrier is put up over five turns. It reduces damage from physical attacks over that time.

items.name: TM34
items.description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. This attack is impossible to evade.

items.name: TM35
items.description: The foe is roasted with a heavy blast of fire. It may leave the target with a burn.

items.name: TM36
items.description: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe with great force. It may also poison the target.

items.name: TM37
items.description: Summons a sandstorm that lasts for five turns. It damages all types except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.

items.name: TM38
items.description: The foe is incinerated with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.

items.name: TM39
items.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the target's SPEED stat if it hits.

items.name: TM40
items.description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It is impossible to evade.

items.name: TM41
items.description: If enraged by this move, the target becomes incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

items.name: TM42
items.description: An attack move that becomes very powerful if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

items.name: TM43
items.description: An attack move that may have an additional effect depending on the battle terrain.

items.name: TM44
items.description: A move that makes the user fall asleep over two turns to restore HP and heal any status problems.

items.name: TM45
items.description: The foe, if it is the opposite gender as the user, becomes infatuated and may not attack.

items.name: TM46
items.description: An attack that gives the user an opportunity to steal the foe's hold item.

items.name: TM47
items.description: The foe is struck with steel-hard wings. It may also raise the user's DEFENSE stat.

items.name: TM48
items.description: A special power is transmitted to the foe, causing it to switch abilities with the user.

items.name: TM49
items.description: A move that steals the effects of any status-changing or healing move that the foe tries to use.

items.name: TM50
items.description: A maximum-power attack of great ferocity, but one that also sharply reduces the user's SP. ATK stat.

items.name: HM01
items.description: Attacks the foe with sharp blades or claws. It can also cut down thin trees and grass outside of battle.

items.name: HM02
items.description: The user flies up on the first turn, then attacks next turn. It can be used to fly to any known town.

items.name: HM03
items.description: Creates a huge wave, then crashes it down on the foe. It can be used for traveling on water.

items.name: HM04
items.description: The user builds enormous power, then slams the foe. It can be used for moving large, round boulders.

items.name: HM05
items.description: Looses a powerful blast of light that reduces the foe's accuracy. It also lights up dark caves.

items.name: HM06
items.description: Hits the foe with a rock-crushingly tough attack. It can smash cracked boulders.

items.name: HM07
items.description: A powerful charge attack. It can be used for climbing a torrential waterfall.

items.name: HM08
items.description: A 2-turn attack in which the user dives underwater on the first turn, then strikes in the next turn.

items.name: OAK'S PARCEL
items.description: A parcel to be delivered to PROF. OAK from VIRIDIAN CITY's POKéMON MART.

items.name: POKé FLUTE
items.description: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any POKéMON. It has a lovely tone.

items.name: SECRET KEY
items.description: The key to CINNABAR ISLAND GYM's front door. It is colored red and decorated.

items.name: BIKE VOUCHER
items.description: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY and exchange it for a bicycle.

items.name: GOLD TEETH
items.description: A set of false teeth lost by the SAFARI ZONE'S WARDEN. It makes his smile sparkle.

items.name: OLD AMBER
items.description: A piece of amber that contains the genes of an ancient POKéMON. It is clear with a reddish tint.

items.name: CARD KEY
items.description: A card-type key that unlocks doors in SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE in SAFFRON CITY.

items.name: LIFT KEY
items.description: A key that operates the elevator in TEAM ROCKET's HIDEOUT. It bears the TEAM ROCKET logo.

items.name: HELIX FOSSIL
items.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a seashell.

items.name: DOME FOSSIL
items.description: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling POKéMON. It appears to be part of a shell.

items.name: SILPH SCOPE
items.description: A scope that makes unseeable POKéMON visible. It is made by SILPH CO.

items.name: BICYCLE
items.description: A folding bicycle that allows faster movement than the RUNNING SHOES.

items.name: TOWN MAP
items.description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

items.name: VS SEEKER
items.description: A device that indicates TRAINERS who want to battle. The battery charges while traveling.

items.name: FAME CHECKER
items.description: A device that enables you to recall what you've heard and seen about famous people.

items.name: TM CASE
items.description: A case that holds TMs and HMs. It is attached to the BAG's compartment for important items.

items.name: BERRY POUCH
items.description: A pouch for carrying BERRIES. It is attached to the BAG's compartment for important items.

items.name: TEACHY TV
items.description: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice TRAINERS.

items.name: TRI-PASS
items.description: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.

items.name: RAINBOW PASS
items.description: A pass for ferries between VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.

items.name: TEA
items.description: An aromatic tea prepared by an old lady. It will slake even the worst thirst.

items.name: MYSTIC TICKET
items.description: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK. It glows with a mystic light.

items.name: AURORA TICKET
items.description: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND. It glows beautifully.

items.name: POWDER JAR
items.description: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.

items.name: RUBY
items.description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a red glow. It symbolizes passion.

items.name: SAPPHIRE
items.description: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.
